periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation with a slight outward slant of approximately 10-15 degrees from the midline at the superior margin.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval with a ratio approximately 1.6:1 height to width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant tapering at the inferior boundary, extending the dark pixels lower than the geometric center of the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior edge where the black band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High lateral thickness, occupying approximately 40% of the visible torso height at the shoulder flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap equivalent to approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semi-circular convex curvature at the top of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: The typically white fur of the head and back shows a distinct tan/brownish chromatic shift compared to the high-contrast black regions.
